name: OH-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Beatty's incumbency and large financial advantage
No competitive polling or expert ratings signaling risk
model.rationale: Joyce Beatty holds a heavily Democratic Columbus-area seat with a D+21 partisan lean, a $2.8 million war chest, and no serious outside opposition, while markets price her near certain to win. With no polls or ratings suggesting otherwise, the fundamentals-based margin stands.
model.watch: A surprise red-wave environment or an unexpectedly funded Republican challenger could narrow the margin, though flipping the seat remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Joyce Beatty, the Democratic incumbent in this Columbus-based district, is seeking another term against Republican Cleophus Dulaney. The seat leans strongly Democratic, with a partisan advantage of about 21 points, and Beatty has raised over $1.2 million with $2.8 million on hand, dwarfing any visible opposition effort. Prediction markets price her win probability near 97 percent.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the financial picture. All of these point the same direction: a comfortable Democratic hold, with the only real question being the size of the margin rather than the outcome.
